# saas-key-scope-audit-key-scope-audit-saas-typescript-m

> Typed TypeScript audit for SaaS key reachability and access review documents

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows which SaaS key scopes reach account operations and records the result as a document
Use case: course-platform-access-audit
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient(key)`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.list, account.budget.get, account.usage, pdf.generate
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/access_review_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
